items.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra
items.summary_en: OpenAI presents GPT-6.1 Terra as a fast, efficient model for visual reasoning and computer use. It is offered to Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users in ChatGPT's Work and Codex surfaces, and to developers in the API. Reported API pricing is $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens.
